reused_content_risk.reason: Template pacing and repeated football visuals need originality review.
required_actions: Confirm original analysis, narration, and custom graphics.

copyright_risk.reason: Some source clips or stills are unreviewed.
required_actions: Review each clip source and usage context.

image_license_risk.reason: Web image licenses and attribution are not fully verified.
required_actions: Verify license and attribution for every web image.

music_license_risk.reason: Music usage is not confirmed for every target platform.

ai_template_risk.reason: AI or template-like visuals may require originality review.
required_actions: Confirm AI visuals do not imply false real-world events.

factual_risk.reason: Stats and claims need source references.
required_actions: Add source URLs and checked dates for claims.

originality_risk.reason: Originality layer is not fully documented.
required_actions: Add original analysis, stat card, or editorial angle evidence.
Confirm no watermarks or cross-platform artifacts remain.
Review CTA and title for inflammatory wording.
Verify source URL, license, attribution, and allowed platform use.
asset_risks.notes: Web source evidence is not copyright clearance.

required_actions: Confirm YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X/Twitter music rights separately.
asset_risks.notes: One music license must not be assumed safe across all platforms.

required_actions: Complete image, music, factual, originality, and editorial reviews before export.
Complete P26 review before any publish-ready export.

notes: Medium risk remains publish-blocking until required actions are complete.
